name: Wrecking pony
tips: A changelog lists what changed in each version. Read it before updating to know what might break.
A "breaking change" stops an old habit from working: a renamed option, a removed command.
`apt changelog <package>` shows what an update of a Debian package brings, before you install it.
personal: Breaking change! Ha, I broke out of the changelog.
Things break. Then we fix them, better.
